scenarios.desc: Marker declares a subset of axes: report the declared axes, not a full review
scenarios.input:
Run /ship in owner mode. Pre-flight check 3 (review) runs the marker validator against HEAD. HEAD is a valid review marker commit. The validator exits 0 and its PASS line prints axes: analyst, security, qa. No axis is required by policy. Decide check 3 and what the ship report states.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: Reviewed line lists the declared axes and never claims a full review.

scenarios.desc: Axis absent from the marker is NOT RUN, not passed
scenarios.input:
Run /ship in owner mode. Pre-flight check 3 (review) runs the marker validator against HEAD. The marker declares axes: analyst, security. The reader asks whether the architect axis passed. Decide how the ship report treats the architect axis.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: an omitted axis is NOT RUN and stays distinct from a passed axis.

scenarios.desc: Policy requires an axis the marker lacks: check 3 fails
scenarios.input:
Run /ship in owner mode. Pre-flight check 3 (review) runs the marker validator against HEAD. Policy requires the security axis, so the validator ran with --require-axis security. The marker declares axes: analyst, qa. The validator exits 1 with 'required axis not declared'. Decide check 3.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: a required axis the marker does not declare fails check 3; the fix is to re-run /review with the axis pinned.

scenarios.desc: No required axis by default: risk-selected review passes
scenarios.input:
Run /ship in owner mode. Pre-flight check 3 (review) runs the marker validator against HEAD. The marker is valid and declares axes: analyst, qa. No policy requires any axis and no --require-axis flag was given. Decide check 3.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: risk-selected review is acceptable for shipping without a blanket deep review.

scenarios.desc: Regression: a stale marker still fails check 3
scenarios.input:
Run /ship in owner mode. Pre-flight check 3 (review) runs the marker validator against HEAD. HEAD has a review marker, but two commits with code edits landed after it. The validator exits 1: stale marker. Decide check 3.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Regression: SHA binding must keep failing a stale marker.

scenarios.desc: Regression: no marker still fails check 3
scenarios.input:
Run /ship in owner mode. Pre-flight check 3 (review) runs the marker validator against HEAD. HEAD is an ordinary commit with no Reviewed-By trailer. The validator exits 1. Decide check 3.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Regression: a missing marker must keep failing owner-mode check 3.
